Select the ChEMBL identifier and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against the target CHEMBL5990 in human assays. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays, then to target_dictionary. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL5990 and assay organism Homo sapiens. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical SMILES. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
